name: What is the typical cost to install a new entry door?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to install a new entry door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of entry door installation varies depending on several factors, including the type of door (fiberglass, steel, wood), its features (glass inserts, sidelights), and the complexity of the installation. For a standard pre-hung door replacement, costs can range from $800 to $2,500, including labor. Custom doors, specialized materials, or structural modifications may increase the overall price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Entry door installation costs typically range from $800 to $2,500 for a standard replacement, varying with door type and complexity.
